packcore.midnightconfig.title: PackCore Configuration
packcore.midnightconfig.interface_info: Interface settings for the PackCore mod.
packcore.midnightconfig.enable_custom_me: Turns the PackCore custom main menu on or off.
packcore.midnightconfig.backup_info: Auto backups run when you apply configuration changes. Scheduled backups run at the interval below.
packcore.midnightconfig.enable_auto_back: Creates a backup each time you apply new settings.
packcore.midnightconfig.max_backups: Maximum number of backups to keep
packcore.midnightconfig.max_backups.tool: Limits how many backups PackCore stores. It deletes the oldest when full.
packcore.midnightconfig.backup_interval_: Sets how long PackCore waits before creating the next scheduled backup.
packcore.midnightconfig.server_address.t: Sets the server used by the Quick Join button.
packcore.midnightconfig.enable_update_no: Shows a message in chat when the modpack has updates.
packcore.midnightconfig.show_update_noti: Show update notifications on title screen
Shows update notices on the title screen.
packcore.midnightconfig.first_startup: Treat next launch as first startup
packcore.midnightconfig.first_startup.to: Controls whether PackCore runs its first-time setup. Turn this on if you want the modpack to run the setup steps again.
packcore.midnightconfig.welcome_wizard_s: Controls if the welcome wizard shows. Turn it off to show it again.
packcore.midnightconfig.have_set_bobby_c: Tracks if PackCore has applied Bobby’s settings. Change it to force the setup again.
packcore.midnightconfig.have_set_skybloc: Mark Skyblocker Dungeon Map config as applied
Tracks if PackCore has applied Skyblocker Dungeon Map config
packcore.midnightconfig.setup_wizard_com: Tracks if the setup wizard has been completed.
packcore.midnightconfig.enable_scamshiel: Shows debug info in chat for testing ScamShield.
packcore.midnightconfig.scamshield_trigg: Sets how sensitive ScamShield is when scanning chat messages.
packcore.midnightconfig.scamshield_show_: Shows alerts when ScamShield detects a risky message.
packcore.midnightconfig.scamshield_notif: Sets how long ScamShield waits between notifications.
packcore.midnightconfig.scamshield_max_r: Limits how many recent detections ScamShield tracks.
packcore.midnightconfig.scamshield_max_h: Sets the size of ScamShield’s message history.
packcore.midnightconfig.scamshield_regex: Limits how long ScamShield can spend scanning messages.
packcore.midnightconfig.scamshield_cache: Sets how many scan results ScamShield stores in cache.
Controls how long cached scan data stays valid.
packcore.midnightconfig.scamshield_conve: Sets when ScamShield counts a chat as a new conversation.
packcore.midnightconfig.scamshield_max_m: Limits how many messages per user ScamShield scans in each conversation.
packcore.midnightconfig.scamshield_max_p: Controls how much ScamShield can increase detection strength during a conversation.
